The admin controller’s `next`/`previous` actions then also mutate `group.offset` (`group.set("offset", offset)` in `admin-group.js.es6`) and call `group.findMembers()`. This confirms pagination/UI state (offset/limit/current member page) is being stored and mutated on the shared domain model rather than being isolated to a controller/route state, which is an architectural/scope concern introduced by this change but not a directly verifiable functional defect from the diff alone.
